encoding: Original generated RGBA PNG copied without image transformations. Genuine alpha transparency preserved.
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: production transparent amplifier-head artwork for the SpectralForge Chimera audio plug-in.
Primary request: an exceptionally convincing photorealistic premium five-channel bass amplifier head named NIFLHEIMR, inspired by the cold primordial Norse realm. Original design, no copied brand or existing amplifier design. Heavy black textured cabinet with softly rounded shoulders, dark forged steel face, satin silver trim and precision manufactured hardware. Two silver raven reliefs on the upper grille corners and restrained intertwining Norse knotwork at the border; faint cold ice-blue light behind fine dark metal grille, frostlike etched crystalline lines integrated into metal trim, not actual snow. A striking raised metal NIFLHEIMR nameplate is centered across the grille, with a tiny SPECTRALFORGE badge immediately below.
Composition/framing: wide landscape exactly 3:1 composition. Full complete amplifier head isolated on genuinely transparent background. Straight-on orthographic front view, horizontally aligned, symmetric level camera, no side perspective. Product fills approximately 96% of width and 90% of height with minimal transparent padding, all case corners, carrying handle and small feet fully inside canvas. Photographic studio asset, no floor or environment, no cast shadow outside object.
Materials/lighting: real black leathergrain cabinet, cast silver ornamental edges, brushed gunmetal aluminum, gently aged stainless screws. Carefully restrained fine machining details and tactile surface texture. Soft studio light upper left, narrow cold edge highlights, deep but readable shadows. Extremely realistic object, not illustration or UI mockup.
Front panel constraints: upper two-thirds is decorative metal grille and nameplate; lower one-third is clean uninterrupted dark brushed-metal fascia. No knobs, switches, sockets, channel buttons, control markers, labels or numeric readouts anywhere: working knobs and channel selection are separate live software controls. Only permitted text is exactly "NIFLHEIMR" in readable imposing metal serif lettering and "SPECTRALFORGE" in small neat capitals. No channel names.
Avoid: neon cyberpunk, blue plastic, transparent cabinet, snow piles, icicles outside enclosure, fog, fantasy landscape, people, speaker cabinet, musical instruments, cables, pedals, mockup screen, watermark. Must have genuine alpha transparency, not checkered texture or painted black background.
integration: Bundled by CMake CHIMERA_ARTWORK and loaded by RasterBank as RGBA.
Uses existing aspect-preserving head() render path for Classic, Dual and Matrix.
Only product branding is baked into the asset; live channel selector and parameter controls remain JUCE components.

inspection.visual_qa: Generated asset inspected: straight-on dark steel/silver head, Norse ravens/knotwork, ice-blue grille lighting, clean lower fascia, transparent cutout.
